status: provisional rule data for phase 1; shared numeric thresholds (keep-last results, pruning start, min freed, result cap, chars per token) are read from tables/compaction.json via compaction/policy.py, never copied here

small_result_chars.why: a result under N chars costs about as much as the note that would replace it, so dropping it saves nothing

dropped_head_chars.why: a dropped result keeps a head of H chars so the model still sees what kind of output it was and can decide to re-run the read

rerunnable_tools.why: reads that can be re-run for the same content, so their results are cheap to drop

side_effect_tools.why: calls that changed state: the fact they happened must stay or the model may redo or contradict them

readonly_bash_prefixes.why: bash commands treated as re-runnable reads; anything else (or any command with redirection, pipes to a writer, or ;/&& chains) is a side effect

mcp_side_effect_words.why: an MCP tool whose name holds one of these acts outside the session; its call must stay

assumed_window_tokens.why: the provider does not learn the backend's context window per turn; 200k is the common Claude window and the smaller of the routed windows, so the pruning start threshold min(cap, pct x W) is estimated conservatively (earlier, not later)
